host: Zen4 7800X3D, native Windows, MSVC addon, AVX-512 auto

badges.detail: PAR2 create, 1 GiB / 1024 slices (1 MiB), R=8; native Windows. GFNI+AVX-512 reference; pow2 slice count for direct PAR3 comparison. Median of 8 back-to-back runs, stdev 6.6 (1.1%)

PAR3 create, 1 GiB / 1024 slices (1 MiB), R=8, Fenger kernel (pow2 slices + pow2 recovery, post-#87); native Windows. Median of 5 runs, stdev 1.4 (2.2%) — re-measured 2026-08-18, within stdev of 2026-08-17 62 MB/s baseline
PAR2 create, 1 GiB / 32768 slices (32 KiB), R=8; native Windows. PAR2's GFNI+AVX-512 is the speed reference for the PAR3 rows. Median of 5 back-to-back runs, stdev 9.65 (1.6%)

PAR3 create, 1 GiB / 32768 slices (32 KiB blocks), R=8, Fenger kernel; native Windows. ~21x behind PAR2 at the same shape. Re-measured 2026-08-18: median 29.60 / mean 29.79 MB/s over 3 measured runs + 1 warmup-discarded (stdev 0.71, 2.4%) — up from 26 MB/s baseline (+14%, AVX-512 thermal headroom during a cooler ambient stretch)

PAR3 create, 1 GiB / 131072 slices (8 KiB blocks), R=8, Fenger kernel; native Windows. ~28x behind PAR2 at the matching slice-count row. Re-measured 2026-08-18: 21.71 / 21.96 / 22.06 MB/s (2 measured runs + 1 warmup-discarded, stdev 0.18, 0.8%) — up from 17 MB/s baseline (+29%, post-#90 RHS fix removed cache thrash on small blocks)

PAR3 create, 1 GiB / 262144 slices (4 KiB blocks), R=8, Fenger kernel; native Windows. ~34x behind PAR2 at the matching slice-count row. Median of 3 measured runs + 1 warmup, stdev 0.08 (0.5%) — re-measured 2026-08-18, flat vs baseline
PAR3 create, 10 GiB / 262144 slices (40 KiB blocks), R=8, Fenger kernel. 40 KiB is non-pow2 (rejected by #87); pending — would need shape change (e.g. 16 GiB / 64 KiB) to run

PAR3 create, 4 GiB / 65536 slices (64 KiB blocks), R=8, Fenger kernel; native Windows. Largest pow2 shape that fits V8's 4 GiB single-Buffer limit (16 GiB / 262144 / 64 KiB overflows). Re-measured 2026-08-18: 26.47 / 25.91 / 26.83 MB/s over 3 measured runs (stdev 0.46, 1.7%) — flat vs 28 MB/s baseline. Note: requires `PAR3_GF64_INPUT_POOL_SIZE=4294963200` (4 GiB - 64 KiB) to bypass the +64 KiB input-pool headroom collision at this shape (lib/par3gen.js:375 — poolSize = totalSize + 64 KiB overflows V8's 4 GiB - 1 cap by 130944 B); see bench-reports/zen4-rerun-2026-08-18/

PAR3 create, 16 GiB / 262144 slices (64 KiB blocks), R=8, Fenger kernel. ARCHITECTURAL LIMIT: V8 caps single-Buffer at 4 GiB and the Fenger single-call path tries Buffer.alloc(totalInputBlocks * blockSize) = 16 GiB (lib/par3gen.js:1766). See issue #91 for the chunked-Buffer fix. Until then, the 4G/65536 row above is the largest measurement we can produce.
